blocks.prompt: 10 (a) A radio tower stands on flat ground with a small antenna mounted at its top. From a point 50 meters away from the base of the tower, the antenna subtends the same angle as a 1 meter vertical rod placed at the base of the tower. The total height of the tower and antenna is 10 meters. Find the height of the tower (without the antenna).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bilkul Example 9 (lighthouse wala) jaisa sawal hai: tower ke ooper laga antenna observer ki aankh par utna hi angle banata hai jitna tower ki base par khari 1 m ki rod.
Diya kya hai? Observer ka fasla 50 m, tower + antenna ki kul oonchai 10 m, rod 1 m.
Find kya karna hai? Tower ki oonchai \(h\) (antenna ke baghair); antenna phir \(10 - h\) hoga.
Plan: har angle ko \(\tan^{-1}\) mein likhein, antenna aur rod ke angles barabar karein, \(\tan^{-1}\alpha - \tan^{-1}\beta\) wala formula lagayein aur \(h\) nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya: observer B, base A se 50 m door; antenna ki choti C, \(AC = 10\) m; tower ki choti D, \(AD = h\); rod ki choti E, \(AE = 1\) m.
Maloom karna: \(h\).
Tareeqa: Example 9 ki tarah triangles ABC, ABD aur ABE teeno A par right-angled hain, is liye B par har angle \(\tan^{-1}\frac{\text{oonchai}}{50}\) hai. Antenna ka angle in mein se do angles ka farq hai.

B par angles likhein
\[\theta = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{10}{50} = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{5}\]
\[\theta_1 = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{h}{50}\]
\[\theta_3 = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{50}\]
Kyun: Right triangle mein \(\tan(\text{angle}) = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}\). Yahan har triangle mein adjacent side zameen par 50 m wala fasla hai aur opposite side oonchai hai.

Antenna ka subtended angle
\[\theta_2 = \theta - \theta_1\]
\[= \tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{5} - \tan^{-1}\tfrac{h}{50}\]
Kyun: Subtended angle (woh angle jo koi cheez dekhne wale ki aankh par banati hai) antenna DC ke liye lines BD aur BC ke darmiyan hai. Is liye bara angle (antenna ki choti tak) minus chhota angle (tower ki choti tak).

Di gayi shart \(\theta_2 = \theta_3\) lagayein
\[\tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{5} - \tan^{-1}\tfrac{h}{50} = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{50}\]
\[\tan^{-1}\dfrac{\frac{1}{5} - \frac{h}{50}}{1 + \frac{h}{250}} = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{50}\]
Kyun: Formula \(\tan^{-1}\alpha - \tan^{-1}\beta = \tan^{-1}\frac{\alpha - \beta}{1 + \alpha\beta}\) do \(\tan^{-1}\) ko ek bana deta hai; yahan \(\alpha = \frac{1}{5}\), \(\beta = \frac{h}{50}\), to \(\alpha\beta = \frac{h}{250}\). Kitab ne Example 9 mein bhi yahi kiya tha.

\(\tan^{-1}\) hata kar simplify karein
\[\dfrac{\frac{1}{5} - \frac{h}{50}}{1 + \frac{h}{250}} = \dfrac{1}{50}\]
\[\dfrac{50 - 5h}{250 + h} = \dfrac{1}{50}\]
Kyun: Dono acute angles ke \(\tan^{-1}\) barabar hain, to andar wali values bhi barabar hain. Phir baen fraction ke ooper aur neeche dono ko 250 se multiply kiya taake chhote chhote fractions khatam ho jayein: \(250 \cdot \frac{1}{5} = 50\), \(250 \cdot \frac{h}{50} = 5h\), \(250 \cdot \frac{h}{250} = h\).
Dhyan dein: Sirf ek hisse ko 250 se multiply na karein; ooper aur neeche dono ko karna hai, warna value badal jayegi.

\(h\) nikalein
\[50(50 - 5h) = 250 + h\]
\[2500 - 250h = 250 + h\]
\[2250 = 251h\]
\[h = \dfrac{2250}{251} \approx 8.96 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: Cross-multiply kiya, phir \(h\) wali terms ek taraf aur numbers doosri taraf. Antenna ki lambai \(10 - 8.96 \approx 1.04\) m hai, jo rod (1 m) ke qareeb hai; samajh mein bhi aata hai, kyunke antenna rod se ooper hai aur door lagta hai, is liye utna hi angle banane ke liye thora lamba hona chahiye.

Tasdeeq
\[\tan^{-1}0.2 - \tan^{-1}\tfrac{8.964}{50}\]
\[= 11.31^\circ - 10.16^\circ = 1.15^\circ\]
\[\tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{50} = 1.15^\circ\]
Kyun: Antenna aur rod dono ka angle \(1.15^\circ\) aaya, bilkul jaisa sawal mein diya tha.
blocks.final_answer:
Tower ki oonchai \(h = \frac{2250}{251} \approx 8.96\) m
Aur antenna takreeban 1.04 m lamba hai.

blocks.prompt: 10 (b) A radio tower stands on flat ground with a small antenna mounted at its top. From a point 50 meters away from the base of the tower, the antenna subtends the same angle as a 1 meter vertical rod placed at the base of the tower. The total height of the tower and antenna is 10 meters. Calculate the subtended angle.
blocks.explanation:
Subtended angle woh angle \(\theta_2\) hai jo antenna observer ki aankh par banata hai.
Diya kya hai? Part (a) ki shart: yeh angle 1 m rod ke angle ke barabar hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(\theta_2\) ki value degrees mein.
Plan: rod ka angle \(\tan^{-1}\frac{1}{50}\) seedha nikal lein, phir part (a) ki heights se tasdeeq karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: part (a) se \(\theta_2 = \theta_3\) aur \(\tan\theta_3 = \frac{1}{50}\); \(h \approx 8.96\) m.
Maloom karna: subtended angle \(\theta_2\).
Tareeqa: Rod ka angle triangle ABE se seedha maloom hai, aur antenna ka angle us ke barabar hai. Is liye lamba hisaab dobara karne ki zaroorat nahi.

Rod ka angle
\[\theta_3 = \tan^{-1}\tfrac{1}{50} = \tan^{-1}0.02\]
\[\theta_3 \approx 1.15^\circ\]
Kyun: Triangle ABE mein opposite \(= 1\) m aur adjacent \(= 50\) m.
Dhyan dein: Calculator degree mode mein rakhein; radian mode mein 0.02 aayega jo angle radians mein hai.

Antenna ka subtended angle
\[\theta_2 = \theta_3 \approx 1.15^\circ\]
Kyun: Sawal ki shart hi yeh hai ke antenna aur rod ek jaisa angle banate hain.

Heights se tasdeeq
\[\theta - \theta_1 = 11.31^\circ - 10.16^\circ\]
\[= 1.15^\circ\]
Kyun: Part (a) wali \(h \approx 8.96\) m se antenna ka angle alag se nikala to bhi wohi \(1.15^\circ\) aaya; dono hisaab ek doosre ki tasdeeq karte hain.
blocks.final_answer:
Subtended angle \(\theta_2 = \tan^{-1}\frac{1}{50} \approx 1.15^\circ\)
Yani antenna aankh par sirf ek degree se thora zyada angle banata hai.
